card.name: Clinical trial registry field labels
card.fires_on: Words inside clinical trial registry entries, such as Title after Official, Date after Primary Completion, the E in CTCAE, and the zeros in NCT numbers.

modes.label: Registry field names
modes.description: The last word of a trial record field label such as Official Title or Estimated Primary Completion Date.

modes.label: CTCAE abbreviation
modes.description: The final letter E in the NCI CTCAE adverse event criteria name.

modes.label: NCT number digits
modes.description: A leading zero within an NCT trial identifier after NCT.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly poster, theme and PI words, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the standard labels and ID codes in clinical trial registry entries.
